title: Synthetic data request intake triage
description: Invented intake-triage policy for a fictional data platform team: route an incoming data request to proceed, clarify/return, or decline/redirect once completeness and appropriateness have been assessed. Synthetic content for specification testing; it authorizes nothing.

decision.intent: Triage an incoming data request into exactly one intake outcome once the completeness of the submission and the appropriateness of the request have been assessed.
decision.question: Should this data request proceed, be returned for clarification, or be declined and redirected?

evidenceRequirements.description: The submitted request carrying every mandatory intake field.
A named accountable business sponsor at or above the minimum seniority threshold.
Data-owner, privacy, and/or legal approvals where sensitive or personal data is present.

sources.title: Example data request intake standard

citation.excerpt: The reviewer assigns exactly one outcome: proceed when complete and appropriate; clarify/return when substantially valid but incomplete or not yet evaluable; decline/redirect when an appropriateness criterion fails in a way more information will not fix.

sources.rights: Invented content for specification testing; not an operational policy.

outcomes.label: Proceed
outcomes.description: Complete and appropriate: accept into the delivery queue, record the accepted scope, and hand off to the build process.

outcomes.label: Clarify / return
outcomes.description: Substantially valid but incomplete or not yet evaluable: return with the specific enumerated gaps, all at once.

outcomes.label: Decline / redirect
outcomes.description: Fails an appropriateness criterion that more information will not fix: decline with a clear reason and, where possible, a redirect or alternative.

rules.description: Decline when the request fails an appropriateness criterion that more information cannot fix, such as no sponsored purpose, consumers not authorized for the data classification, a data-residency breach, duplication of an existing asset, or the wrong delivery mechanism.
rules.rationale: The cited standard treats a hard appropriateness failure as a decline, not a clarification.

rules.description: Return for clarification when mandatory fields are missing or ambiguous, when approvals or triggered reviews are merely pending, or when appropriateness cannot yet be judged.
rules.rationale: The cited standard returns substantially valid but not yet decidable requests with enumerated gaps.

rules.description: Proceed when every mandatory intake field is complete, every appropriateness criterion passes, and the mandatory evidence is present.
rules.rationale: The cited standard accepts complete and appropriate requests into the delivery queue.

exceptions.description: Embargoed material non-public information reaching recipients outside the authorized set, or ahead of public release, is a hard decline: restrict to the authorized set and escalate to the disclosure office.

escalation.message: Escalate to the intake reviewer: enumerate the missing intake fields or unresolved appropriateness criteria, note any conflicting rules, and route embargoed-information questions to the disclosure office.
